Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Macina: Holding a consultation forum to address concerns in the cercle
Mali.summary: Macina, 18 November (AMAP) The Cercle Prefect, Albaraka Ag Amarizag, met in the prefecture's conference room with the authorities and traditional leaders, the defence and security forces, the heads of technical departments, the umbrella organisations of civil society – in short, all those who have a say in the life of the town, as AMAP observed. There was only one item on the agenda, namely discussions between him and the traditional authorities, the heads of technical departments and the umbrella organisations of civil society.

Mali.title: Mali’s Air Force receives major boost with delivery of Il-76 transport aircraft, Mi-8 and Mi-24 helicopters
Mali.summary: Mali’s armed forces have received seven Russian-made aircraft, including an Ilyushin Il-76TD transport aircraft, four Mi-8 helicopters and two Mi-24 attack helicopters, as Bamako continues to expand its air mobility and combat-support capabilities. The aircraft were formally handed over at Modibo Keïta-Senou International Airport in Bamako on 16 November during a ceremony presided over by transitional President General Assimi Goïta, Mali’s commander-in-chief.

Mali.title: Nioro du Sahel: The efforts of the FAMa...
Mali.summary: Nioro du Sahel: The efforts of the FAMa are promoting the resumption of economic activities and transport The efforts of the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) to improve security and facilitate the free movement of people and goods are contributing to the gradual return to normality in Nioro du Sahel. . The arrival of several dozen fuel tankers, the resumption of transport links with Bamako and Kayes, and the restocking of markets are all signs of this change after nine months of severe disruption.

Mali.title: Nioro du Sahel: FAMa's efforts are helping to revive economic activity and transport
Mali.summary: Transport companies have welcomed the resumption of the service. The arrival of several dozen fuel tankers, the resumption of transport links with Bamako and Kayes, and the restocking of markets are all signs of this development after nine months of severe disruption. .

Mali.title: Expelled from Guinea: More than 1,100 people still present at the Bamako site
Mali.summary: As part of the return operations, a lorry was mobilised on 16 November from the Kouremalé assembly site to transport around 110 people, including four to the Bamako District and 106 to Burkina Faso. On 17 November, the Burkinabé authorities also deployed 20 buses, two military trucks and 16 medical ambulances to ensure the care and return of their compatriots.

Mali.title: Road safety issues in Mali: 2 deaths and 33 serious injuries on the roads every day
Mali.summary: "2 deaths and 33 serious injuries every day on the roads". This alarming toll was highlighted by Ousmane Bah Maïga, Director General of the National Road Safety Agency (ANASER), on Sunday, 15 November 2026, in Bamako. This was during a training session held at the Maison de la Presse for 60 journalists from traditional media and digital platforms.

Mali.title: Mali: The FAMa target bases and logistics depots of armed groups in Abeïbara and Sévaré
Bamako, the new battleground for influence, or why the AFRICOM Commander visited the arms fair...
Mali.summary: Bamako, the new battleground for influence, or why the AFRICOM Commander visited the arms fair in Mali Russia, Türkiye and the United States are continuing their rivalry for military and political influence in the Sahel. This is what the BAMEX defence and security exhibition, which has just taken place in Mali, demonstrates. .

Mali.title: Washington is preparing for the "biggest financial attack" on Iran, and the latter is threatening to respond "harshly".
Mali.summary: Washington prepares for "biggest financial attack" on Iran, which threatens to respond "harshly" DW.com

Burkina Faso.title: Press Release | SN CITEC: Notice of recruitment of associations and organisations of stevedores in Bobo-Dioulasso
Burkina Faso.summary: Notice of Expression of Interest: No. 2026-33364/DG/NPK Recruitment of associations or organisations of stevedores on behalf of SN CITEC 1- Purpose of the services SN CITEC wishes to pre-select associations or organisations to carry out, at its sites, the loading, unloading and handling of raw materials, finished products and other goods, as well as their movement, storage and stacking .

Burkina Faso.title: Flow of underage children to gold mining sites: In Dédougou, “Polisi I Nisonisa” raises awareness
Burkina Faso.summary: Launched in March 2026 in the Bankui region, Polisi I Nisonisa, which means "the police, my neighbour" in Bwamu, is a community policing initiative that focuses on dialogue and proximity to enhance security. As part of this approach, its teams visit neighbourhoods and public places to engage with local residents about their security concerns. .

Niger.title: Tahoua: Significant quantity of weapons and ammunition seized in Ibecetane
Niger.summary: A large quantity of weapons and ammunition was seized by the Niger National Guard (GNN) in Ibecetane, in the rural municipality of Akoubounou, Abalak Department (Tahoua Region). This seizure was presented to the Governor of the region, Colonel-Major Souleymane Amadou Moussa, on Monday, 16 November 2026, on the premises of the Tahoua Regional District of the NGG.

Niger.title: Nigeria: The army is authorised to pursue armed fighters up to 5 km into Niger, Chad and Cameroon
Niger.summary: Abuja now wants to target armed groups beyond its borders. In an announcement made in Abuja on 16 November, Nigerian Defence Minister General Christopher Musa stated that his forces could cross the border by a maximum of five kilometres when pursuing attackers. Indeed, according to the Minister, Cameroon, Niger and Chad have agreed to this right of cross-border pursuit.

Niger.title: In Niger, Algeria is taking steps to secure its interests in the Sahel
Niger.summary: An Algerian army convoy arrived in Niger on 31 October, marking the first deployment of Algerian troops abroad. A first in 53 years! The last time Algeria sent troops abroad was in 1973, to support Egypt during the Arab-Israeli War.

Niger.title: In Niger, a terrorist logistics base...
Niger.summary: In Niger, a terrorist logistics base destroyed in the Tillabéry region The Niger National Guard neutralised two terrorists and dismantled a logistics base of armed terrorist groups located near Kobagué, in the Torodi Department, Tillabéry region. This was announced by the National Guard on 17 November in a press release. .

Niger.title: Niger: New attack in the Dosso region, in the south-west
Niger.summary: In Niger, an attack took place last week in the department of Dioundou, in the Dosso region, in the south-west of the country. For the time being, no official casualty figures have been released. A visit to the bereaved families following the terrorist attacks carried out in several villages in the rural commune of Dioundiou This is how the Nigerien news agency reported the visit on Saturday of Colonel Major Bana Alhassane, the Governor of the Dosso region, to the Dioundiou department, which borders Nigeria.

Niger.title: Nigeria: The country signs a new military agreement with Cameroon, Niger and Chad
Niger.summary: A new military agreement has been signed between Nigeria, Cameroon, Niger and Chad. It should enable Nigeria to pursue armed fighters beyond its borders. Nigeria now intends to be able to pursue armed fighters up to a five-kilometre strip in neighbouring territory.

Niger.title: New attack in the Dosso region, in south-western Niger
Niger.summary: In Niger, an attack took place last week in the Dioundou Department, in the Dosso region, in the south-west of the country. For the time being, no official casualty figures have been released. Published on: A visit to the bereaved families following the terrorist attacks carried out in several villages in the rural municipality of Dioundiou This is how the Nigerien news agency reported the visit on Saturday of Colonel Major Bana Alhassane, the Governor of the Dosso region, to the department of Dioundiou, which borders Nigeria.

Niger.title: Nigeria signs a new military agreement with Cameroon, Niger and Chad
Niger.summary: A new military agreement has been concluded between Nigeria, Cameroon, Niger and Chad. It should enable Nigeria to pursue armed fighters beyond its borders. Published on: Nigeria now intends to be able to pursue armed fighters up to a distance of five kilometres into neighbouring territory .
